name: fund-fee-recompute-check
title: Fund Fee Recompute Check
description: Recompute a fund's management fee from the declared fee base, rate, and day-count convention, and the performance fee from the declared hurdle, high-water mark, and crystallisation policy; diff the recomputed figures against caller-supplied charged amounts as a values-only comparison (ART-511), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). All fee bases, rates, and charged amounts are caller-supplied inputs; the verdict is an arithmetic finding, never a determination that a fee is reasonable or unreasonable. Not investment advice.

steps.handoff: Recomputes the management fee from the declared fee base, rate, and day-count convention, and the performance fee from the declared hurdle, high-water mark, and crystallisation policy; diffs the recomputed figures against caller-supplied charged amounts where supplied; execution_hash cited by the terminal step
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)
